scope: Local synthetic fixtures only; fresh disposable localhost PostgreSQL; no production data, account or funds access.

reproduction.modulePathNote: Replace the two local path placeholders with installed local dependency paths. They are filesystem modules, not remote services. Playwright uses a local Chromium installation. Run Vite in a separate terminal with the recorded environment before the runner; no CLI arguments are required.
reproduction.databaseNote: The package runner starts embedded PostgreSQL on localhost in a fresh temporary cluster when QA_PG_ADMIN_URL is unset. The local module directory contains pg and @embedded-postgres/windows-x64. Build backend and frontend before running it.

19. provider outage and rate limit are errors, never an empty success; stored queue stays readable

Daytime schedule (Kyiv): first admin open after 07:00, 12/16/20 slots, no night scans, no night catch-up, dedupe; manual always; load
Reconciliation: every CREDITED row has one admin audit; balances equal credited sums
Notifications: committed rows only, overlap/recovery never emits duplicate deposit IDs
Notifications: real publisher performs zero Prisma queries; delivery outage cannot roll back discovery
